headline: A diagnostic laboratory needed to be legally and operationally ready before its first patient.
challenge: A diagnostics business carries patient-data sensitivity and health-sector compliance obligations on top of the usual corporate requirements, the margin for error is thin.
delivered: Regulatory and permit documentation for diagnostic service operations
Data protection advisory for patient and employee information handling
Administrative and compliance support for day-to-day operations
impact: A diagnostics provider structured to operate lawfully, protect patient data, and scale its testing services on a compliant footing.
